segments.name: MASH
segments.description: Develops and commercializes Rezdiffra, an oral liver-directed therapy for adults with noncirrhotic MASH and moderate to advanced liver fibrosis.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as one reportable segment focused on delivering novel therapeutics for MASH.

revenueModel.text: Patients and payers in the United States and Germany pay for Rezdiffra prescriptions, which the company sells as its only approved product.
revenueModel.evidence: Rezdiffra is our first and only approved product.
